newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CAMACHO TO REJOIN ESPANYOL AS COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAMACHO TO REJOIN ESPANYOL AS COACH.

text.p: Former Spain international Jose Antonio Camacho said on Tuesday that he would rejoin first division Espanyol as coach next season.

Camacho took Espanyol out of the second division and won a UEFA Cup place in his three years at the club. He moved to Sevilla last year but was unable to repeat the success and resigned earlier this season.
